title: Mouse movement
help: Sends a relative movement with Windows SendInput. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down. Delay postpones the start. Duration 0 or one step sends the whole motion at once; multiple steps distribute the exact total ΔX/ΔY across the duration. For one action per key press, use If key down → On new press. For repeated motion while held, choose While held and Repeat until stopped. A second block with negative deltas can reverse the motion after a Wait.
